title: 天皇賞（春）の後に・二強

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After an intense battle, Satono Diamond is first across the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black admits defeat and compliments Satono Diamond's performance. Until someone interrupts them, that is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's Mejiro McQueen and Tokai Teio. Impressed by Satono Diamond and Kitasan Black both, they've come to challenge them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen has decided to run in the autumn Tenno Sho, and Tokai Teio in the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond wants to run in the autumn Tenno Sho. I give my approval, but suggest the Kyoto Daishoten as a warm-up.
